note: The app-server protocol carbon's Codex harness is written against. Generated from the pinned binary and checked in, so a version bump fails on a digest rather than at three in the morning on a client box. install regenerates both digests from the binary it just unpacked and refuses on a mismatch.
bundle_sha256_is: sha256 of the bundle manifest: one '<sha256>  <relative path>' line per file, sorted by path, newline terminated. One hex string covers every file the subcommand wrote, and the manifest itself says which file moved.
generated_on_machine: the build machine, darwin arm64, against the Homebrew-installed codex-cli 0.153.4
